answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 25787 Country: India Title: My wife has recently unfortunately had a miscarraige during ramadhaan, as a result she has stopped fasting. Does she have to pay kaffarah aswell as make the fast up at a later date, what is the ruling? Question: Salaams My wife has recently unfortunately had a miscarraige during ramadhaan, as a result she has stopped fasting. Does she have to pay kaffarah aswell as make the fast up at a later date, what is the ruling? Answer ID: 25787 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1550/10005/L=1431) You did not write why did you stop fasting. Had you sent the question in the beginning of Ramadan with the explanation of pregnancy period and the later situation we would have written the ruling regarding keeping fast. As far as the matter of kaffarah is concerned, if your wife did not keep the fast, there is no kaffarah; it is enough to keep the missed fasts. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
